# Reverse text

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/reverse-text/

Reverse a text by visible grapheme clusters, reverse the order of words, or reverse its lines while keeping each line intact.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Reverse a list from newest-first to oldest-first without changing the text inside each line.

## Limits and checks

Grapheme-aware character reversal needs Intl.Segmenter support. Word reversal normalizes the spacing between words.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
